card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables and counts
card.fires_on: Digits, commas or spaces partway through a multi-digit number, such as a fraction count (49/115), a dose table row, or a dollar amount. It fires mid-number, before more digits follow.

modes.label: Counts in fractions
modes.description: A digit inside a patient count or percentage fraction in trial results.

modes.label: Numeric table rows
modes.description: A space or digit inside rows of numbers in a dosing or calculation table.

modes.label: Dollar amounts
modes.description: A comma or digit inside a large dollar cost figure.

card.writes: It promotes money and finance words, which is a weak fit and likely a side effect of dollar amounts.
